examples.translation: A solar year is the time it takes for the Earth to orbit around the Sun.

examples.text: Het zonnejaar is iets langer dan het kalenderjaar.
examples.english: The solar year is slightly longer than the calendar year.
examples.translation: The solar year is slightly longer than the calendar year.
